tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List published SO4AG sources (organizations) with role, revision and claim count. By default only sources a company published or confirmed itself; include_proposals adds unconfirmed proposals prepared from public websites.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Return the full published SO4AG manifest of a source.

tools.name: get_claims
tools.description: Return claims of a source evaluated for a task: property (e.g. refundableDeposit, totalPrice, acceptedPaymentMethods) and scope (e.g. {"branch": "...", "vehicle_class": "economy"}). Each claim says whether it is usable now and why not.

tools.name: check_claim
tools.description: Check one claim by its id: validity now, digest, dispute and attestations.
